summary.prose: The build makes four independent changes to the write path for workflow artifacts: the LLD heading gains the Story title, alternatives are rebuilt from the step that wrote them, non-path citations are held to the file-reference rule, and client-authored artifacts record who wrote them. Nothing changes for artifacts already stored. The largest risk is existing test fixtures that submit incomplete alternatives, which the alternatives task must update.

tasks.title: Show the Story title in the LLD heading
tasks.summary: Add optional storyTitle to the LLD meta, set it on the Epic and standalone finalize paths, and render it in the H1 when present.
acceptanceChecks: A new LLD's H1 reads 'LLD: <id> — <title>' on both finalize paths
A title with a line break renders on one line
A stored LLD with no storyTitle renders byte-identically

tests.name: title: the H1 shows id and title
title: a title with a line break renders on one line
title: the H1 shows id and title on both finalize paths
stored: a stored LLD with no storyTitle renders byte-identically

tasks.title: Rebuild alternatives from the alternatives step at finalize
tasks.summary: Export isAlternative, add the overlay before the standalone branch with unique one-to-one ids, non-retryable handling of a malformed s2 and the no-s2 fallback, relax the synthesis schema and prompt, and update fixtures that submit incomplete alternatives.
acceptanceChecks: Stored alternatives equal s2's records, keeping only the submitted reasonRejected
A submission whose content differs from s2 is accepted and s2's values are stored
Mismatched or duplicate submitted ids are refused as retryable
A malformed s2 is refused as non-retryable, naming a restart, and writes nothing
A run with no s2 output accepts complete alternatives and refuses incomplete ones
isLldBody is unchanged, so stored LLDs still read

tests.name: overlay: a submission with only ids and reasonRejected stores every s2 field
overlay: a submission that alters s2's content stores s2's values
finalize: duplicate submitted ids are refused as retryable
finalize: an id absent from s2 is refused as retryable
finalize: an s2 alternative missing from the submission is refused as retryable
finalize: duplicate s2 ids are refused as non-retryable
fallback: a run with no s2 output accepts complete submitted alternatives
fallback: a run with no s2 output refuses an id-only submission
finalize: both the Epic and the standalone path apply the overlay
finalize: an incomplete s2 record is refused as non-retryable, naming a restart, and writes nothing
stored: isLldBody still accepts a stored LLD with partial alternatives

tasks.title: Enforce the file-reference rule on non-path citations in LLDs
tasks.summary: Add checkNonPathCitationRefs beside pathFormProblem and call it only from finalizeDesignStory.
acceptanceChecks: The DeepSeek LLD's actual refs are refused
A badly formed path-only ref, a root-level file name with prose and a URL with prose are refused
A text-only label, a well-formed path and a standalone URL pass
A refused citation names its id and writes nothing
checkPathForms is unchanged and other artifact kinds are unaffected

tests.name: citations: the DeepSeek LLD's actual refs are refused
citations: a badly formed path-only ref under analyze-bundle is refused, as under code
citations: a root-level file name alongside prose is refused
citations: a URL alongside prose is refused
citations: a text-only label, a well-formed path and a standalone URL all pass
citations: a refused citation names its id, writes nothing and succeeds when corrected
citations: other artifact kinds are unaffected
stored: checkPathForms behaviour for other artifact kinds is unchanged

tasks.title: Record the real client and reported model on client-authored artifacts
tasks.summary: Widen the stamp's runner to include 'unknown', add clientAttribution, add optional authorModel to the synthesize input and the workflow-step tool, build the stamp in handleSynthesize from the step context, and forward attribution on the standalone path.
acceptanceChecks: A Codex client with a reported model stamps cli-codex and that model
An absent, blank or multiline authorModel stamps unknown
A client with no family stamps runner unknown
A supplied multi-output attribution stays unchanged on both finalize paths
The source type-checks with the widened runner and modelSummary prints an unknown stamp

attribution: a Codex client with a reported model stamps cli-codex and that model
attribution: a supplied multi-output attribution stays unchanged on both finalize paths
